summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting in the repository, without committing or running tests. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a (ControlType, str) ControlCode variant; rich/control.py adds the ESC ] 0 ; title BEL format entry and Control.title(); rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(), which returns True when a control is written and False otherwise; rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gains an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200; tests added in tests/test_control.py, tests/test_console.py (skipped on win32), and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (win32 only). Not verified: Black formatting and the test suite, since I was instructed not to run anything.
